use_graph_mutation_enum: use the GraphMutations enum with NO_MUTATION, DEL, or ADD values to represent graph mutation types
use_graph_vert_skip_token: use GRAPH_VERT_SKIP_TOKEN to filter English stopwords except 'you' when checking knowledge graph vertex overlap
use_location_constants: use LOCATION_NAME and LOCATION_DESCRIPTION constants as dictionary keys for location metadata in the Jericho world
use_set_delimiters: use SET_MEMBERS_DELIM and GRAPH_DELIM constants to parse or join sets of objects and graph edges
use_empty_graph_token: use EMPTY_GRAPH_TOKEN to represent an empty knowledge graph state in the Jericho world task
